detail.title: Analysis of Unstructured Knowledge Editing and Foundational Reasoning Limits
detail.summary: Investigated unstructured knowledge editing (UnKE) and causal-guided adaptive knowledge editing (CAKE) to determine how automated reasoning models can detect and correct foundational premise errors.
detail.reason: Revising notebook-assumption-falsification with new unstructured knowledge editing evidence (UnKE) and CAKE methodologies.
